title: Amsterdam concert, visiting Ben Webster in Copenhagen and his death
summary: On a tour with Sarah he took time off to visit Ben Webster in Copenhagen, and soon after Ben died; Rowles says Ben was like a father.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: But the guy from Amsterdam, Root de Toot(?), or whatever his name is, Root de Voot(?)... I never did get to meet him. Because he wanted the whole group that made the record where she sang "Thelonious Monk," which was my song, and everybody chickened out but me. Because I wanted to see Ben Webster. I hadn't seen him. And he was in Copenhagen.

So when we finished playing the concert in Amsterdam, she gave me some time off, which was very extraordinary. I didn't have to be back until the day after my birthday. So I said, 'That's just great.' So I went to Copenhagen, surprised Ben, stayed with him for a little over a week. And, 'Ta-ta, I've got to go back.' I got back to Belgium, and there was no message, they hadn't taken care of my room, which they were supposed to do -- I had to pay for that. Then I got mad, so I just had my ticket changed. So I didn't go to Amsterdam and went right straight back to New York. Then I stayed here about two or three days, then I went right straight to Los Angeles.

Then I'm sitting in Los Angeles and I got a call from Root(?) in Copenhagen. Ben had had a stroke and died in Amsterdam. So at least I got to see Ben the last couple of weeks before he died. He was like my father.
